# Theme files are read-only

- You may inspect theme files to understand the project, but do not modify, create, delete, or rename files in theme directories.
- If a requested change appears to require editing a theme file, explain the restriction and ask the user to update this instruction before proceeding.
- Keep this restriction in this separate file so the user can revise or extend it later without changing the language instructions.
